summary.en-US: Adds the job advert you're viewing to your own self-hosted Job Tracker in one click: its link, title and, on LinkedIn, the company. Needs your own Job Tracker instance.

version.approval_notes: Companion to Job Tracker, a self-hosted job application tracker (https://github.com/lukebrewerton/job-tracker). The toolbar button opens <instance>/jobs/new?url=…&title=… in a new tab, using only the active tab's URL and title (activeTab); the instance address is a setting (storage.sync) with no default. It makes no network requests itself. To try it without an instance, save any https:// address in the options and select the button on a web page: a new tab opens at that address's /jobs/new with the page's URL and title in the query. Plain JavaScript, no build step or minification: the package is the source (https://github.com/lukebrewerton/job-tracker-extension).
